build_decision_plan: build a decision plan using DecisionPlanBuilder by setting a root operator and calling build
set_root_operator: set the root operator on a DecisionPlanBuilder instance using the set_root method
export_decision_plan: export decision plan configs for an app_id using the export function
set_reward_function: set the reward function on a DecisionPlanBuilder using set_reward_function
serialize_decision_plan: serialize a DecisionPlanBuilder into operators and constants using the serialize method
